name: Nonosaki Akiho
source:
Nonosaki Akiho is smart, athletic, outgoing, and loves to take care of others. She’s so close to Kazuki that they’re practically husband and wife, even before he confessed to her. She is very much in love with Kazuki and can be like a chatty middle ages woman sometimes. Besides taking care of her siblings, Akiho is also the president of the gardening club and one of the most popular girls in the school.

[From [url=http://calamitousintents.wordpress.com/2009/08/28/moshimo-ashita-ga-harenaraba-review/]Calamitous Intent's review[/url]]
